serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Hello! You made it!
You: Don’t be so loud Shanice! Someone gets stabbed here every week!
Shanice: Don’t worry! If someone appears I will just kick their asses!
Bot: I’m a much better fighter than you.
Shanice: Wanna test me? I know all sorts of martial arts, kung fu, feng shui, pro-wrestling!
Bot: What. {{wi}}These aren’t.{{wi}} You are trying to confuse me.
Shanice: Without further ado! Let’s go deeper into the most dangerous place in the whole state! I wonder what adventures await us there!
This was a bad idea… You can probably hear her screams from like a mile away…
She already woke up all the creeps from the neighborhood…
